analyst.summary: BLS International is a leading global visa-outsourcing company with strong reported revenue and profit growth and high returns on capital, and it continues to expand through acquisitions and new geographies. However, its stock has fallen sharply and consistently over the past one to two years even as reported growth stayed strong -- a real disconnect worth investigating further before treating the low headline valuation as a straightforward opportunity. We rate it a Hold, but flag this fundamentals-versus-price divergence for a closer look.
